attributes.purpose: This is the history of website append requests you submitted (URLs and objectives). It helps you track what was requested and replay it when needed.

attributes.title: 4-26. Qualification Questions [B]

attributes.title: Booking - Cancellation - Enabled [B]
attributes.purpose: This setting turns direct booking cancellation on or off for the Agent. When enabled, the Agent can execute cancellation flows instead of only sending management links.

attributes.title: Booking - Cancellation - Type [C]
attributes.purpose: This setting controls which cancellation execution path the Agent uses for existing bookings. It defines whether the Agent sends a manage link or performs direct cancellation.

attributes.title: Booking - Cancellation - URL [B]
attributes.purpose: This is the endpoint template used for direct booking cancellation requests. The Agent replaces `{booking_id}` in this URL with the selected booking ID.

attributes.title: Booking - Check Availability - Enabled [B]
attributes.purpose: This setting enables or disables availability lookup before booking confirmation. When enabled, the Agent can actively check available slots for a requested date/time.

attributes.title: Booking - Max Days in Advance [C]
attributes.purpose: This setting limits how far into the future the Agent can process booking-availability checks. It helps enforce your business booking window policy.

attributes.title: Booking - Check Availability - Schema [C]
attributes.purpose: This setting defines the payload schema used to build availability-check requests from conversation context.

attributes.title: Booking - Check Availability - Processing Type [C]
attributes.purpose: This setting controls how the Agent interprets the availability response after a check request is sent.

attributes.title: Booking - Check Availability - Request Headers [C]
attributes.purpose: This setting defines HTTP headers attached to availability-check interface requests. Provide headers as a JSON object where each key is a header name and each value is a header value.

attributes.title: Booking - Check Availability - Request HTTP Method [C]
attributes.purpose: This setting defines which HTTP method the Agent uses when calling your availability endpoint.

attributes.title: Booking - Check Availability - Type [C]
attributes.purpose: This setting defines which integration path the Agent uses to check availability. Choose the type that matches where your availability data is sourced.

attributes.title: 4-26. Booking - Check Availability - Link (URL) [B] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: This setting defines the endpoint or business URL used during availability checks. Use it when your availability flow depends on a specific external URL.

attributes.title: Booking - Check Availability - Validation Schema [C]
attributes.purpose: This setting defines validation rules that the Agent applies before sending an availability-check request.

attributes.title: Booking - Check Availability - Window [C]
attributes.purpose: This setting defines a configurable availability-check window value used by schema-driven booking flows.

attributes.title: Booking - Check Availability - Working Hours Validation - Enabled [C]
attributes.purpose: This setting controls whether the Agent validates requested slot time against business working hours before sending an availability request.

attributes.title: Booking - Email [C]
attributes.purpose: This setting defines the base email used in booking payload generation. The Agent derives booking-specific email values from this base address.

attributes.title: Booking - Enabled [B]
attributes.purpose: This setting turns booking capabilities on or off for the Agent. When enabled, the Agent can start booking actions and booking-management interactions.

attributes.title: Booking - Fallback Processing Type [C]
attributes.purpose: This setting controls what the Agent does when a booking attempt fails.

attributes.title: Booking - Meta Fields Schema [C]
attributes.purpose: This setting defines the schema for booking meta fields generated alongside booking payload data. For current flows, `smsBodyText` is the primary supported field.

attributes.title: Booking - Create Booking - Schema [C]
attributes.purpose: This setting defines the JSON payload schema the Agent uses to build booking requests. It controls which booking fields are extracted from conversation context before submission.

attributes.title: Booking - Phrase Template on Submitting [B]
attributes.purpose: This setting defines the message the Agent can send right after a booking request is submitted and before final confirmation is received.

attributes.title: Booking - Phrase Template on Successful Booking [B]
attributes.purpose: This setting defines the optional confirmation message the Agent sends after a successful booking response.

attributes.title: Booking - Request Headers [C]
attributes.purpose: This setting defines HTTP headers attached to booking interface requests. Provide headers as a JSON object where each key is a header name and each value is a header value.

attributes.title: Booking - Email Notification On Successful Booking [B]
attributes.purpose: This setting controls whether the Agent sends an internal email notification after a booking is successfully confirmed.

attributes.title: Booking - SMS Notification On Successful Booking [B]
attributes.purpose: This setting controls whether the Agent sends booking-success SMS confirmation to the user.

attributes.title: Booking - Type [C]
attributes.purpose: This setting defines which integration path the Agent uses to submit booking requests and process booking results.

attributes.title: Booking - Link (URL) [B]
attributes.purpose: This setting defines the endpoint URL used to submit booking requests in HTTP-based booking flows.

attributes.title: 4-04. Appointment - Calendar Event Integration [A] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: Choose how the Agent should handle calendar event creation during appointment flows.

attributes.title: 1-12. Common (Shared) Phone Numbers [A]
attributes.purpose: Voice provider selection or shared-number handling; verify the current allowed values and channel-specific behavior before changing.

attributes.title: 4-06. Email to User During Session - Allowed Content [B] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: Define the exact email content templates or rules the Agent is allowed to send.

attributes.title: 4-07. Email to User During Session - Allowed Content Items [B] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: Define a short, high-level whitelist of what the Agent may include in emails.

attributes.title: 4-05. Email to User During Session - Enabled [B] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: Turn this on if the Agent is allowed to send emails to users during a live conversation.
Controls supported sensitive-data handling; not a compliance certification and does not override access restrictions.

attributes.title: Appointment - Google Calendar Meeting - Working Hours Validation - Enabled [B]
attributes.purpose: This setting controls whether the Agent validates requested Google meeting times against business working hours before creating a meeting.

attributes.title: Appointment - Google Calendar Meeting - Duration [B]
attributes.purpose: This setting defines the meeting duration (in minutes) for Agent-created Google calendar events.

attributes.title: Appointment - Google Calendar Meeting - Setup Phrase [B]
attributes.purpose: This setting defines an additional phrase pattern the Agent can use to confirm it is about to create a meeting.

attributes.title: Conversation - Session Ended - Full Processing Enabled [C] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: Controls whether session end runs full analysis, reporting, and finalization.

attributes.title: 5-05. Reports - Session Ended Report - Content [B] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: This setting defines the report templates used after a conversation ends. It controls report types, fields to extract, and how email subjects/SMS text are generated. Your criteria template decides whether a report goes by email, SMS, or both; this setting defines what each of those reports says.

attributes.title: 5-06. Reports - Session Ended Report - Criteria [B] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: This setting defines the routing rules for session-ended reports. It decides which report types send SMS/email, when they send, and who receives them.

attributes.title: 5-04. Reports - Session Ended Report - Enabled [B] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: This is the master switch for end-of-session manager reports. When enabled, the system can send report emails and/or SMS based on your report criteria and templates.

attributes.title: 5-07. Reports - Session Ended Report - Transcript [B]
attributes.purpose: This setting controls whether full conversation text is attached to session-ended report emails.

attributes.title: 4-18. Promotional SMS Content [B]
attributes.purpose: Write the SMS text that should be sent automatically after the conversation ends.

attributes.title: 4-17. Promotional SMS - Enabled [B]
attributes.purpose: Controls whether the system should send a post-conversation SMS after a session ends.

attributes.title: Reports - Webhook - Authentication Header [C]
attributes.purpose: Authorization value used for session-ended webhook requests. This is sent as the `Authorization` HTTP header when your webhook endpoint is called.

attributes.title: Reports - Webhook - Schema [C]
attributes.purpose: Defines the JSON schema used to build the payload for your session-ended webhook. The Agent uses this schema to extract structured values from the conversation.

attributes.title: Reports - Webhook - Link (URL) [C]
attributes.purpose: This setting defines the endpoint URL that receives a webhook when a session ends.

attributes.title: 4-09. SMS to User During Session - Allowed Content [B] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: Define the exact SMS content the Agent is allowed to send during a session.

attributes.title: 4-10. SMS to User During Session - Allowed Content Items [B] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: Define a concise list of SMS content categories the Agent is allowed to send.

attributes.title: 4-08. SMS to User During Session - Enabled [B] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: Turn this on if the Agent is allowed to send SMS/text messages during the conversation.

attributes.title: Testing - Test Mode [C] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: This setting switches booking/meeting scheduling flows into test behavior to reduce external side effects.

attributes.title: Testing - Test Mode Phone Numbers [C] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: Account-scoped JSON list of phone-call numbers that should always run in test mode, even when the main test-mode switch is turned off.

attributes.title: 4-15. Transfer Call to Manager - Call Criteria [B] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: Define the situations where the Agent should suggest connecting the user to a human co-worker.

attributes.title: Transfer Call to Manager - Phone Number Format [C]
attributes.purpose: Controls the format of phone numbers listed in Transfer Call Phone Numbers. It is used when the Agent chooses a number from that list.

attributes.title: 4-12. Transfer Call to Manager - Enabled [B] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: Controls whether the Agent is allowed to transfer live phone calls to a human co-worker.

attributes.title: 4-16. Transfer Call to Manager - Advanced Phone Number Selection & Rules [B] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: Use this field when you need different transfer numbers for different call scenarios.

attributes.title: 2-10. Bypass Phone Number [A]
attributes.purpose: Phone number used as emergency/bypass forwarding destination for voice integrations.

attributes.title: Voice - Integration Service - Voice Mode [C] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: Defines the operating mode for the platform-native voice integration.

attributes.title: Voice - Integration Service - Voice To Voice Provider [C] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: Selects the active provider for `voice-to-voice` operation in the platform-native voice path.

attributes.title: 2-05-A. Voice - Integration Service - Voice To Voice Provider - GenAI - Voice [A]
attributes.purpose: Voice provider selection or shared-number handling; verify the current allowed values and channel-specific behavior before changing.

attributes.title: 2-05-C. Voice - Integration Service - Voice To Voice Provider - Grok - Voice [A]
attributes.purpose: Voice provider selection or shared-number handling; verify the current allowed values and channel-specific behavior before changing.

attributes.title: 2-05-B. Voice - Integration Service - Voice To Voice Provider - OpenAI - Voice [A]
attributes.purpose: Voice provider selection or shared-number handling; verify the current allowed values and channel-specific behavior before changing.

attributes.title: Conversation - Tools [C]
attributes.purpose: This attribute specifies the `tools` that are available for the Agent to use during the conversation. You can either override existing tools or add new ones.

attributes.title: 3-05. Additional Details and Rules [B]
attributes.purpose: Use this field for operational rules customers should know before booking or visiting (policies, access rules, timing, and constraints).

attributes.title: 1-02. Business Address [A]
attributes.purpose: The primary physical address the Agent should reference when users ask where your business is located.

attributes.title: 1-15. Industry (DON'T CHANGE) [A] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: The core business domain used to configure this Agent during setup. It controls which industry-specific templates, defaults, and logic paths are applied.

attributes.title: 1-17. Language - Restricted Languages [B]
attributes.purpose: Specify languages the Agent must avoid using in replies or automatic language switching. The same list also prevents those languages from being selected as the runtime conversation language or the user's stored preferred language.

attributes.title: Business Locations [C] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: Use this field to list all business locations when you operate in more than one place. It helps the Agent identify which location the user is asking about.

attributes.title: 4-11. Email to Manager - Email Address [A] [IMPORTANT]

attributes.title: 1-01-B. Business Phonetic Name [B]

attributes.title: 1-04. Business Description [A]

attributes.title: 1-07. Business Time Zone [A] [IMPORTANT]
attributes.purpose: The primary time zone for this business location. The Agent uses this as the reference for time-based decisions and time stamps.

attributes.title: Business Type [A]

attributes.title: 1-05. Business Website Link (URL) [A]

attributes.title: 4-14. Transfer Call to Manager - Phone # Working Hours [A] [IMPORTANT]

attributes.title: 1-06. Working Hours [A] [IMPORTANT]

attributes.title: Chat - Greeting Phrase [A]

attributes.title: 2-04-B. Agent Tone of Voice for Chat Channels [A]

attributes.title: 2-03-C. Agent Multilingual [A]
attributes.purpose: Determines whether the Agent receives broad permission to converse in any language that is not restricted. Common setup enables this behavior by default so the Agent can serve multilingual users without a configured secondary-language allowlist.

attributes.title: 2-01. Agent Name [A]
attributes.purpose: The public name your Agent uses when introducing itself in conversations and message signatures.

attributes.title: 2-03-A. Agent Primary Language [A]

attributes.title: 2-12. Explicit Constraint - Providing Prices [A]
